prompt.project_info: Create a candid, eye-level patio portrait with a warm authentic daytime cafe atmosphere and natural smartphone-photo character.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, peaceful closed-eye expression and natural skin texture. She wears a comfortable casual brown top and holds a red canned beverage while enjoying a drink; preserve the supplied relaxed posture and non-performative expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium close portrait centered on the adult woman's face and upper torso. In the supplied first-image action, she lifts the red can toward her lips; if rendering the alternate moment, her hand lowers the can just out of frame after drinking. Include a warm outdoor cafe or patio, wooden table edge, indistinct patrons and beverage dispensers in a softly blurred background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daytime light with warm gentle highlights and realistic mild shadows. Keep the mood relaxed, authentic and unretouched, with natural background color and slight phone-camera softness.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 vertical smartphone portrait, eye-level medium close framing, sharp natural facial detail, soft background blur, realistic hair and fabric texture, restrained warm color and no beauty filter.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a candid eye-level patio portrait of one original approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, a peaceful closed-eye expression and natural skin texture. She wears a comfortable casual brown top and holds a red canned beverage while enjoying a drink. In the supplied first-image action, she lifts the can toward her lips; for the alternate moment, her hand lowers the can just out of frame after drinking. Use a medium close portrait centered on her face and upper torso, with a warm outdoor cafe or patio, wooden table edge, indistinct patrons and beverage dispensers softly blurred behind her. Use soft natural daytime light, warm gentle highlights, realistic mild shadows, slight phone-camera softness and authentic unretouched color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, invented logos, altered can branding, readable added text
